document.title: Peraturan BPJS Kesehatan 2/2024: Penagihan, pembayaran, dan denda iuran JKN

delta.note: The regulation amends BPJS Kesehatan procedures for billing, collecting and paying JKN contributions. It covers collection through JKN cadres for PBPU/BP participants, local-government payment rules, late-payment fines for inpatient services, and compliance supervision. It does not change contribution rates, wage bases or caps, or any element that enters the PPh 21 gross income or deductions of permanent employees. The fines borne by employers for PPU participants are penalties tied to arrears, not a change to the regular contribution or the tax calculation. The document is therefore administrative or enforcement only.
